entities.name: Infanta María de la Paz of Spain
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Infanta María de la Paz of Spain was a Spanish infanta, daughter of Queen Isabella II. She married her cousin Prince Ludwig Ferdinand of Bavaria and lived the rest of her life in Germany, dedicating her time to her family, charity work and writing poetry. She wrote a book of memoirs: Through Four Revolutions: 1862–1933.
